a: cron schedules recurring jobs with crontab expressions.
export VAR=value sets an environment variable in the shell.
alias ll='ls -la' creates a shortcut command.
which cmd shows the path of an executable.
head shows the start of a file; tail shows the end.
less is a pager for scrolling through long files.
grep -c pattern file counts matching lines.
sed can replace text streams, e.g. s/old/new/g.
awk processes columns of text with patterns and actions.
